subject: world_language
concept: Unit review and mastery check for the full Wonder + Discovery Band World Languages curriculum, confirming CEFR B1 threshold readiness
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Mixed set of future-plan and unplanned-situation questions spanning nodes 01-07
exercise.abstract: Mixed reasoning, comprehension, writing, and extended-conversation questions spanning nodes 01-07

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed question types, plus a passing extended conversation and written sample
misconception_flags: any single-node misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
next_node_on_fail: WORLDLANG.P6.FLUENCY_BRIDGE.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
